AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E. Broadway, Room 105 (MSB 105)
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during

CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  December 11, 2019
  City Council Chambers

l.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:06 pm.

  Present: Manoukian, Ghazarian, Devine, Abkarian, Chair MacCarley

  Items were taken out of order with the sequence being as follows: Item 1, §, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13,
  14, 15.

6.  PRESENTATION OF GLENDALE LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY AND GLENDALE SUPERVISORY
  ACADEMY - CLASS OF 2019 (VARDANYAN)

  Mr. Doyle and the members of the Commission acknowledged and congratulated the graduates.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of November 13, 2019.

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Abstained: Chair MacCarley

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  None

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

S.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS SERIES (PETROSYAN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Wireless Communications Series as submitted.

  The class specification for Wireless Communications Series was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

8.  CLASS SPECIFICATION AND JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-ASSISTANT FIRE MARSHAL (BABAYAN)
  Action: Approval of class specification and job bulletin for Assistant Fire Marshal as submitted.

  The class specification and job bulletin for Assistant Fire Marshal was approved as submitted by the following
  vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of December 11, 2019
  Page 2 of 3

9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- FIRE ENGINEER (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Fire Engineer as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Fire Engineer was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

10.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-LIBRARY, ARTS & CULTURE ADMINISTRATIVE MANAGER (PETROSYAN)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Library, Arts & Culture Administrative Manager as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Library, Arts & Culture Administrative Manager was approved as submitted by the
  following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Manoukian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

11.  REPORT ON THE FORMATION OF ORAL INTERVIEW PANELS AND THE USE OF INTERNAL RATERS ON SAID
  PANELS (DOYLE)
  Action: For discussion and appropriate action.

  After an extensive discussion, three items have been isolated for discussion by the Civil Service Commission.
  The Commissioners requested for the reports to be presented within 90 days.

  1) Commissioner Ghazarian motioned to add an additional question to the Oral Panel Rater Conflict of
  Interest Questionnaire: "Have you ever been a witness or a party to any dispute, complaint, claim, or
  administrative or legal action involving any candidate or a member of a candidate's immediate or
  extended family or by marriage?".

  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

  2) Commissioner Abkarian requested a report that would explore the possibility of removing the Overall
  Likelihood of Success dimension from the Oral Panel Rating Sheet.

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

  3) Commissioner Devine requested a report that would explore the possibility of limiting the Internal Oral
  Panel composition to only the members of the Executive and Management teams.

  Motion: Devine  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

12.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-POLICE CAPTAIN (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Police Captain as submitted.

  Commissioner Ghazarian motioned for an amendment to the Police Captain hiring process that would adjust
  the scoring weights to be 50% for the Professional Panel, 25% for the Internal Panel, and 25% for the
  Community Panel.
   •
  Civil Service Commission Minutes of December 11, 2019
  Page3 of 3

  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Manoukian, Ghazarian, Devine, Abkarian
  Vote: Noes: Chair MacCarley

  The amended job bulletin for Police Captain was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Chair MacCarley  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

13.  REPORTS- INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

14.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  None.

15.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 8:23 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and correct record of our proceedings of D cember 11, 2019.
